title: PACO: Provocation Involving Action, Culture, and Oppression
benchmark_measurement: Detection of provocative speech against Indian Muslims, categorized by action, religious culture, and religious oppression.
findings: The paper introduces PACO, a dataset of 7,000 sentences annotated for three types of provocation against Indian Muslims (action, religious culture, religious oppression). The best-performing model for identifying this speech was a fine-tuned RoBERTa, achieving a 0.851 average AUC score. The study also conducted a pragmatic analysis, identifying six common dialog acts (e.g., Accusation, Defaming Muslims) and finding that negative impoliteness and bald-on-record were the most prominent impoliteness super-strategies used.
